description: CrossCode + 3 DLC (v1.4.2-3, native Linux NW.js, GOG)
long: CrossCode is a retro-inspired action RPG set inside a fictional massively multiplayer online game, following the mute player-character Lea as she recovers her memories. It combines fast 2D combat and ball-throwing puzzle mechanics with a deep story and exploration across a sci-fi fantasy world. This build includes the game's three additional DLC content packs.
